mr_description:
Rework the logic a bit to collect the anchors and only then load them.
This allows inlining `_try_load_conftest` and making the logic easier to
follow.

expected_issues.title: test* sub-directories of the invocation dir no longer searched for conftests
expected_issues.description:
When no argument is an existing path, only invocation_dir is used as anchor; the removed _try_load_conftest also loaded its test* subdirectories, so <invocation_dir>/tests*/conftest.py are no longer initial conftests.

_try_load_conftest(anchor) loaded conftests of the anchor and of each `test*` sub-directory. The refactor inlines this for explicit anchors but the fallback `anchors = [invocation_dir]` skips the test* scan. Running plain `pytest` from the project root therefore stops loading tests/conftest.py early, so options registered with pytest_addoption there are unknown (usage errors) and early hooks are missed. The fallback must add the invocation dir's test* sub-directories too.
